title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Fragmentation using Opentrons OT-2
author: Amy Denton
materials: After selecting your protocol, choose ‘Start setup’:
For the ‘choose robot step’, select the OT-2.
Switch off the Opentrons® OT-2 robot.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA samples in a 2 mL 96-well deep-well KingFisher plate.

substeps.instruction: Mix each sample in its original storage tube by pipetting carefully with a wide-bore pipette tip.
Use a wide-bore pipette tip to transfer the volume required for a maximum of 5000 ng of DNA into a fresh well of the KingFisher plate (up to a maximum volume of 300 µL).
Transfer samples down each column of the plate (e.g., sample one in A1, sample two in B1, sample three in C1, etc.).
Top-up each sample to the required volume of 300 µL using buffer EB.
Label this plate as the 'Sample Plate'.

steps.title: Configure Opentrons OT-2 Software
steps.instruction: Set up the shearing protocol using the Opentrons app on a laptop.

substeps.instruction: Open the Opentrons app and use 'Devices' to confirm the OT-2 is connected.
Under 'Protocols', select the appropriate shearing protocol based on the number of samples and their location in the KingFisher plate.
Perform calibration and offset measurements as required.

steps.title: Load OT-2 Hardware
steps.instruction: Load the required labware onto the OT-2 starting deck according to the 'Labware & Liquids' map view.

substeps.instruction: Load the tip box into slot 2.
Load the Sample Plate into slot 1.
Ensure tips are loaded so the robot can take from the first row of the tip box.
Remove the lid of the tip box.
Check and empty the OT-2 bin if required to prevent overflow.

steps.title: Execute Shearing Protocol
steps.instruction: Run the automated shearing process on the OT-2.

substeps.instruction: Close the OT-2 door.
Click 'Start run' in the Opentrons app.
Visually confirm that the robot loads all tips and that pipettes are drawing up liquid.
Monitor the run, especially during transition periods between columns (each column takes approximately 30 mins), to ensure tip disposal and attachment of new tips occur without issue.

steps.title: Post-Shearing Handling
steps.instruction: Retrieve the processed samples and proceed to clean-up or storage.

substeps.instruction: Remove the Sample Plate from the OT-2 once the program is complete.
Either proceed to automated SPRI clean-up on the KingFisher Apex (per Sanger Tree of Life Fragmented DNA clean up: Automated SPRI v2) or store samples at 4 °C.
If storing in the fridge, ensure the plate is sealed to prevent evaporation.
